row.notes: Takes the mode at career+0xf08 (or, when its type check matches the wrapper type 0x14612bca8, the first non-wrapper child in +0x238..+0x240) and loops the slot pointers at +0x268..+0x270. The slot equal to the current one (+0x280) with (byte +0x171 & 0x14) == 0 and byte +0xd0 == 0 is passed to Game_InstantRace_FlagSaveSlot(mode, slot, 1). Returns the AND of byte +0xd1 over all slots whose +0x171 bit 0 is clear (true if there are none). Context from caller: FeTile_Route_CareerItem and FeHome_Unk_141726160 open the new-career path only when it returns false and at least one slot has bit 0 clear; Game_TOPLevelUI_CurrentCareerCompletedProgressSave pairs it with its Current Career completed log, so +0xd1 reads as a per-slot completed flag. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
